svg.title: Exploded view of warm-up net n7
svg.desc: Three stacked conductor layers from the supplied warm-up layout. Highlighted polygons share one disjoint-set root and therefore form a single electrical net; via cuts are drawn as vertical plugs.
svg.text: carries the signal between the two via stacks
